messages:
maya_sales: FYI Ventara wants a POC next week to validate 'vent-30b-slim' and an aggressive quant variant 'vent-30b-q4f' for their orchestration workflows. Needs: catalog compatibility, latency numbers for streaming, answers to their security questionnaire (KMS/HSM + residency), and a rough POC price. Can we triage?

eli_se: I can own the model-fit checks. Do they use long-memory prompts or short agent commands?

maya_sales: Mostly short commands (10-40 tokens), but they append a 1.2k token transcript occasionally. Traffic is bursty from edge devices.

zoe_infra: Important: vent-30b-slim v3 uses a sharded KV layout that favors tiled-kv for throughput, but tiled can inflate tail latency on mixed short+long spikes. We'll need a mixed-seq bench.

ben_sec: Security side: they require BYOK, data locality in US-EAST, and attestation that model binaries are scanned. Hosted POC preferred, Dedicated if HSM is mandatory. Any PHI concerns?

maya_sales: They said not PHI but sensitive telemetry. BYOK + US-EAST will be fine if we can provide KMS passthrough.

hana_prod: For the questionnaire we can supply our model onboarding summary and outline KMS options. I'll draft the language once we confirm deployment mode.

ci-bot: Spinning ephemeral test cluster for vent-30b-slim. Run ID: 11457.

zoe_infra: Suggested bench command (internal):

```bash
redwood-bench --model vent-30b-slim --variant vent-30b-q4f,baseline --quant q4f --kv-layout tiled-kv --seq-dist vent-seq-mix.json --concurrency 10 --streaming true --report p95,tokens_per_sec
```

zoe_infra: I'll run tiled-kv and compact-kv sweeps. If we see >30% p95 increase on spikes we'll recommend prefix-KV caching or a canary on the q4f variant.

eli_se: Also request 40 representative prompts from Ventara so we can run a fidelity diff between baseline float16 and q4f. We should run deterministic sampling to compare outputs.

zoe_infra: Bench quick-pass: short-only p95 float16=85ms, q4f=105ms. Mixed with 1.2k spikes p95 float16=460ms, q4f=720ms at concurrency 10 on tiled-kv. compact-kv reduced q4f p95 to ~540ms but lowered tokens/sec by ~12%.

hana_prod: Noted — will include perf trade-offs in POC note and propose two mitigations: (1) prefix caching for repeated transcripts, (2) route short commands to vent-30b-q4f and long contexts to float16 baseline.

ben_sec: For questionnaire: draft answer for KMS: "Hosted POC: customer-managed keys via KMS passthrough; HSM-backed key storage available on Dedicated/Private deployments." For binary scans: "We run checksum validation and static artifact scans; full third-party attestations can be scoped for Dedicated."

eli_se: On quality: q4f introduces subtle tokenization differences and ~3% delta on command parsing in our quick diff. Ask Ventara to provide 40 prompts ASAP; with that we can quantify exact delta and recommend which paths to pin to baseline.

maya_sales: I'll ask their CSM to upload prompts today. Can we get bench, sec answers, and a one-page POC price by Wed EOD? Demo scheduled Thu.

ci-bot: Test run 11457 completed: vent-30b-slim v3 deployed on dev-shared-pool. Logs attached.

zoe_infra: I've uploaded harness config and logs. Action items: @eli_se run fidelity diffs on 40 prompts; @ben_sec finalize questionnaire answers with BYOK wording and residency confirmation; @hana_prod prepare POC pricing card and short playbook. Deliver Wed EOD.

eli_se: Will run diffs once prompts arrive. Expect a short summary: delta rate, example differ cases, and recommended pinning.

ben_sec: If Ventara insists on HSM for hosted, escalate to solutions and sales because that becomes Dedicated. Otherwise BYOK hosted + US-EAST is OK.

hana_prod: Draft pricing: 2-week hosted POC block (discounted token rate + 24/7 support for demo) with optional Dedicated uplift for HSM. Sharing details in private.

maya_sales: Perfect. CSM says they will send the 40 prompts before EOD. Thanks team — I'll keep the demo tentative until we validate outputs. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Run artifacts archived to internal storage (run 11457).
